description: This file defines the 'TransactionRepository' interface, extending JpaRepository for Transaction entities. It provides methods for querying transactions by account ID and for retrieving transactions involving either of two account IDs, supporting history and transfer views.

classes.name: TransactionRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for accessing Transaction data with custom query methods based on account IDs.

methods.name: findByAccount_Id
methods.description: Retrieves a list of transactions for a specific account ID.

methods.name: findByAccount_IdOrAccount_Id
methods.description: Retrieves transactions where the account ID matches either of two provided IDs, supporting transfer history queries.
